notes.title: Free Demo
notes.content:
Demo is out !


We are pleased to annouce that the free demo is available.

If you want to share feedback or report a bug, please do so via this form :

https://forms.gle/RWodcBdQuiqbwJzCA

notes.title: V0.3.0
notes.content:
Changes

 New boat kitchen where everything slides with the waves.
 New recipes across all levels.
 Game now plays per shift of a certain time.
 New streak system that will add bonus points if you keep on making perfect orders.
 New bonus points when an order is delivered fast.
 Added highlight of elements on supplies screen.
 Changed the layout of various levels.
 Added Fire and fire extinguishers.
 New achievement related to fire.


Fixes

 Volume slider set to a logarithmic scale.
 Bug that would cause some object to float ove plates.
 Fixed bug whith hand "too weak" to hold a plate with food.
 Fixed a bug where the order wouldn't cycle to the next one unless it was perfect.

notes.title: V0.2.6
notes.content:
Fixes

 Hand will return to default rotation faster than before.
 Fixed audio minimum volume.
 Fixed a bug where extreme brightness could occur in food truck.

Changes

 Tutorial level now has a darker background.
 Reduced shine on some items that would cause excessive "blinking".

notes.title: V0.2.5
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed object highlight bug.
 Fixed hand slowly descending without input from the player.

notes.title: V0.2.4
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed unnatural shaking of the hand while holding and pushing an object downwards.
 Various minor audio fixes.

notes.title: V0.2.3
notes.content:
Changes

 		Steam cloud support
 		Switched A&B buttons in menu navigation
 		Increased contrast in settings from pause menu

notes.title: V0.2.2
notes.content:
Changes

 Changed default controller prompts from switch pro controller to Xbox controller icons
 Added UI prompts auto-switch based on Keyboar&mouse/gampepad.
 Added 7 achievements

Fixes

 Sliders interaction in menus

notes.title: V0.2.1
notes.content:
Changes
		
 Credits separated from settings panel.
 		Settings are now accessible in-game.
 		Added Music, SFX and UI slider.
 		Added additional message in level 2 when every dirt spot is cleaned but fruits and cans are still present in to provide more guidance.
 		Changed cans in level 2 to an opened state.
 		Tweaks of FoodTruck & Speeding FoodTruck shaking values
 		Halved the required velocity to cut a box open.
 		Added shortcut for box opening

Fixes
		
 Fixed order timer starting before player join
 		Fixed items respawning indefinitely in level 3
